nights.title: MUNA
nights.name: Muna
nights.extract: Muna is an American indie pop band consisting of Katie Gavin, Josette Maskin, and Naomi McPherson. They released two studio albums with RCA Records, About U (2017) and Saves the World (2019), before signing with independent label Saddest Factory Records, which released their third studio album, Muna, in June 2022, and Dancing on the Wall in May 2026.

nights.title: Seb Lowe
nights.name: Seb Lowe
nights.extract: Sebastian Lowe is an English singer-songwriter from Saddleworth, Greater Manchester. He is known for incorporating politics into his music, having started out uploading videos of his songs to TikTok.

nights.title: Paris Paloma
nights.name: Paris Paloma
nights.extract: Paris Paloma is a British singer-songwriter and guitarist. She gained prominence through the single "Labour" (2023). Her debut album, Cacophony, was released in 2024. Her second album, The Fatal Flaw, followed in 2026.

nights.title: Radio Free Alice
nights.name: Radio Free Alice
nights.extract: Radio Free Alice is an Australian post-punk band from Melbourne.

nights.title: Jesse & Joy
nights.name: Jesse & Joy
nights.extract: Jesse & Joy is a Mexican pop duo. It was formed in 2005 in Mexico City by brother and sister Jesse and Joy Huerta.
